title: Allergy Tracker
description: Log allergy exposures, symptoms, and severity with summaries, saved in your browser.
howto: Enter the date and the suspected allergen.
Tick the symptoms you experienced and set the severity 1-5.
Add optional notes and save the episode.
Review counts by allergen and average severity in the summary.

faqs.a: Only in your browser's localStorage. Nothing is uploaded.
It counts episodes per allergen and the average severity, which can help you spot patterns to discuss with a clinician.
No. It is a personal log. Only a clinician can diagnose allergies.
